title: Require Service Source Authority
forbids: missing or alternate spine anchors, competing implementation exports, barrel re-exports, mismatched operation names, and multiple runtime authorities in contract, module, or router leaves
why: Stable file roles make the service legible without freezing the vendor call that constructs each value. One implementation owner adapts the complete contract, and one operation name connects its contract, router, and semantics proof.
remediate: Export only Context from base.ts and implementation from impl.ts; export only contract, module, or router from their composer files; and give each contract or router leaf one lower-camel export matching its kebab filename.
message: Service source files must own one stable role and operation identity.
